sources.note: Organisation profile added 2026-09-14; classification and headquarters from the lab's own site.

profile_text.body:
Google Research is a for-profit research lab headquartered in Mountain View, CA, USA, according to its own site. The lab says it publishes research papers across a wide range of domains and shares developments in AI and science research, publishing hundreds of papers each year and collaborating with universities, NGOs, partners, and communities worldwide. It describes a human-centered approach to AI and states that its work covers AI/ML foundations, responsible human-centric technology, science and societal impact, computing paradigms, and algorithms and optimization. It also describes a research effort to bring together foundation models with generative AI to accelerate geospatial problem solving.

The site frames research as a cycle in which breakthroughs lead to impact on products, science, and society, and states a goal of building a world where AI serves as a partner for researchers, scientists, clinicians, teachers, users, and businesses.

Among the facts held about the company, it is recorded with a presence in California, with a count of 281. No products, lawsuits, or MCP servers are listed for it.
